# Axiom

> Desktop app for developers. Open a project folder and chat with a model that can see those files, use Git, a terminal and Docker. Chats, settings and provider keys stay on the machine. Beta for macOS, Windows and Linux.

Axiom is not a hosted chat. It runs locally. Agent mode reads and edits project files and runs sandboxed commands. Plan and Ask only read. Debug runs commands and diagnostics and does not change files. @ in the composer inserts a file, an older chat, a rule, a skill, or a pipeline of up to three steps.

Models: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, Qwen, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Ollama, a GGUF file, or a custom endpoint. A cloud provider receives the prompt for that request, including attached files. A local model does not upload the repo.

Installers are GitHub Releases. There is no Axiom account. Cloud model use is billed by the provider you connect.

Languages: English at https://getaxiom.ru/ and Russian at https://getaxiom.ru/ru/.
